_comment: Copy this file to tracker-settings.json then fill in telegramBotToken / telegramChatId. tracker-settings.json is not committed due to .gitignore (token protection).
_idleMinutes: If continuous inactivity exceeds this time(min) + CPU is below threshold classify as idle(abandoned session). Active sessions always use CPU within 1 hour to prevent false positives.
_cpuThresholdPct: During the tracking interval if CPU usage is this % or higher treat as 'active' and update lastActiveAt. Below this idle accumulates.
_trackIntervalMin: Background tracking(snapshot) interval(min). When registering Task Scheduler run -TrackActivity at this interval.

alert._ramPctThreshold: Alert if total idle/orphan process memory is this % or more of total RAM (OR condition).
alert._idleCountThreshold: Alert if idle/orphan process count is this value or more (OR condition).
alert._idleMemMBThreshold: Absolute total idle/orphan process memory(MB) threshold (OR condition).
alert._cooldownMin: No further alert within this time(min) after the previous alert (prevent spam).
